text_to_image_prompt:
Masculine gentle androgynous adult art student aged 24. Soft charcoal-black ear-to-nape-length layered hair parted off center with outward flicked ends, olive-brown almond eyes, gently long face, straight brows, small beauty mark near left jaw . Ivory open-collar shirt and muted bottle-green cardigan. Thoughtful neutral expression, no typography.

Create one fictional adult in premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D CG rendering, detailed individually resolved hair strands, natural delicate skin texture and crisp clothing and ornament materials. A landscape 1536x1024, 3:2 close-up head-and-upper-shoulders turnaround sheet. Three equal-width views in one horizontal row: LEFT true straight-on FRONT view with direct gaze, CENTER exact 90-degree PROFILE facing image-left, RIGHT exact 180-degree BACK view with no face visible. Same identity, hairstyle, clothing and accessory locations across all views. Camera at eye height, level upright head, neutral closed lips, matching head scale and crown levels, complete crown in frame. Pure opaque white background, soft even neutral studio lighting, natural cranial proportions. No text, labels, borders, watermarks, extra people, hands or full body.
Rear view: preserve medium-short layered hair length and natural silhouette, with opaque side layers covering both ears.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Produce ONE final three-view portrait sheet at EXACTLY 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 landscape. Input 1 is the ORIGINAL HIGH-DETAIL MASTER and primary edit target, authoritative for identity, facial geometry, colors, hair strand definition, sharpness, skin texture, clothing and ornament detail. Input 2, if supplied, is ONLY a placement guide for the previously corrected hair; do not copy its softened or degraded texture. Reconstruct directly from ORIGINAL MASTER, not by re-editing the softer guide. Match or exceed the crisp fine detail of input 1: individually resolved fine hairs, clean eyelashes and iris texture, natural skin microtexture, sharp embroidery/knit and jewelry edges, no blur, no waxy smoothing, no painterly smearing, no low-resolution upsampling, no sharpening halos or oversaturated contrast. Maintain same original semi-realistic 3D CG look. Keep the original three equal panels, left straight front, center exact left-facing side profile, right exact back, level camera, identical crop/head scale and white background. Preserve all facial identities, proportions, expressions and outfits. No text or watermarks. RIGHT BACK PANEL: layered MEDIUM SHORT black hair conceals BOTH ears fully; preserve original nape length and feathered ends. Do not add long hair. All face/head/eye/clothes detail in other panels must match original master. Keep LEFT FRONT and CENTER PROFILE unchanged from the original master.
original_prompt_label: 最终图生图编辑提示词；完整历史见证据记录
